name: Housing and Land Survey 2023, rent of private rented homes by floor area

measures.definition: Average monthly rent of privately rented homes used only for living, of 30-49 m², in the area, leaving out homes let for nothing (every tenancy), October 2023.

caveats: Every tenancy, however long ago it began: newcomers usually pay more.
